name: RUST-broccoli
description: A dedicated server for Rust, with optional Oxide (uMod) plugin support and a built-in RCON tool. Set RCON_PASSWORD before you start the server. Forward these ports on your router: 28015 TCP and UDP (game), 28016 TCP (RCON), and 28082 TCP (Rust+ app). The settings in this template write over the server configuration on each start. To keep your own configuration, set GENERATE_SETTINGS to false. To send RCON commands, run: docker exec rust-server rcon-cli "say Hello" Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

paths.name: Server Files
paths.description: Server files, game data, and configuration.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: Game port (TCP). Must be the same as SERVER_PORT.

ports.name: Game Port UDP
ports.description: Game port (UDP). Forward it on your router. Must be the same as SERVER_PORT.

ports.name: RCON Port
ports.description: RCON port (TCP). Must be the same as RCON_PORT.

ports.name: RCON Port UDP
ports.description: RCON port (UDP). Must be the same as RCON_PORT.

ports.name: App Port
ports.description: Rust+ companion app port (TCP). Must be the same as APP_PORT.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Required. Password for RCON access.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Description in the server browser.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players that can connect.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: Size of the map. 3000 to 6000 is recommended.

variables.name: Server Seed
variables.description: World generation seed. The same seed gives the same map.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: standard, softcore, or hardcore.

variables.name: PvP
variables.description: Enable player-versus-player combat (true or false).

variables.name: Server Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated tags for the server browser, for example vanilla,monthly,pve.

variables.name: Oxide Enabled
variables.description: Install the Oxide (uMod) plugin framework (true or false).

variables.name: Map Type
variables.description: Procedural Map, Barren, HapisMountain, SavasIsland, or SavasIsland_koth.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Direct URL to a custom map file. If set, MAP_TYPE is not used.

variables.name: Max Team Size
variables.description: Maximum players per team. Leave empty for the server default.

variables.name: Server Era
variables.description: Era for primitive mode servers. Leave empty unless you run primitive mode.

variables.name: Decay Scale
variables.description: Structure decay scale. 0 is no decay and 1 is the default.

variables.name: Stability
variables.description: Enable the structure stability system (true or false).

variables.name: Radiation
variables.description: Enable radiation in radtowns (true or false).

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Seconds between world saves.

variables.name: Server Secure
variables.description: 1 enables VAC and the public server listing. 0 is a private or sandbox server.

variables.name: Server Encryption
variables.description: 0 is none, 1 is weak, and 2 is strong. Some mods need a weaker setting.

variables.name: Server Identity
variables.description: Folder name for server data and saves. If empty, SERVER_NAME is used.

variables.name: Server URL
variables.description: Website URL for your server.

variables.name: Server Header Image
variables.description: HTTP URL of a header image for the server browser.

variables.name: Server Logo Image
variables.description: HTTP URL of a logo image for the server browser.

variables.name: Startup Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments for RustDedicated, added after all other arguments, for example +server.tags monthly,vanilla.

variables.name: Generate Settings
variables.description: Apply the settings from this template on each start. Set to false to keep your own server configuration.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Download and validate the server files from Steam on each start. Set to false to skip.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Game port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

variables.name: RCON Port Variable
variables.description: RCON port the server listens on. Must be the same as the RCON Port.

variables.name: App Port Variable
variables.description: Rust+ app port the server listens on. Must be the same as the App Port.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions.
